import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Group by 'intro.pathway' and calculate mean 'mrt' and success metrics
grouped = invasion_success.groupby('intro.pathway').agg(
    mean_mrt=('mrt', 'mean'),
    mean_invaded_plots=('number.of.invaded.plots', 'mean'),
    mean_area_occupancy=('area.of.occupancy.10km', 'mean')
).reset_index()

grouped

# Perform an ANOVA to test if 'mrt' differs significantly across pathways
anova_model = ols('mrt ~ C(intro.pathway)', data=invasion_success).fit()
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(anova_model, typ=2)
anova_table

# Perform a regression analysis to examine the interaction between 'mrt' and 'intro.pathway' on 'number.of.invaded.plots'
interaction_model = ols('number.of.invaded.plots ~ mrt * C(intro.pathway)', data=invasion_success).fit()
summary = interaction_model.summary()
summary

# Reload the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Group by 'intro.pathway' and calculate mean 'mrt' and success metrics
grouped = invasion_success.groupby('intro.pathway').agg(
    mean_mrt=('mrt', 'mean'),
    mean_invaded_plots=('number.of.invaded.plots', 'mean'),
    mean_area_occupancy=('area.of.occupancy.10km', 'mean')
).reset_index()

grouped

# Perform ANOVA using scipy.stats.f_oneway
pathways = invasion_success['intro.pathway'].unique()
mrt_by_pathway = [invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == p]['mrt'] for p in pathways]
f_stat, p_value = stats.f_oneway(*mrt_by_pathway)
f_stat, p_value

# Prepare data for regression with interaction terms
